messages:
incident-bot: AUTO-PAGE fired -> service=inference-gateway env=prod region=eu-west1 metric=5xx_rate threshold=5% current=9.8% :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: PD incident created: PD-INC-4521, responders paged (primary:oncall-engineering). Link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-INC-4521

Kim: acked oncall (I've got it, joining). pulling up dashboard now. :coffee:

Jordan: seeing same in grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/prod/inference-gateway/5xx?region=eu-west1 spikes across 3 AZs, not just one. error class: 502/504/503 mix.

Sam: logs from gateway show upstream timeouts + 502s from proxy pool. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:11:03Z inference-gw proxy=proxy-12 upstream=backend-23 status=502 rc=EPIPE latency=1203ms
2026-03-15T02:11:04Z inference-gw proxy=proxy-13 upstream=backend-21 status=504 rc=ETIMEDOUT latency=3001ms
```

Maria: any recent deploys? deploy-bot shows a canary pushed to eu-west1 ~02:05, image: inference-gw:v3.4.1-canary. Noted increased tail latency in perf tests earlier.

Kim: ok. immediate mitigations: 1) throttle noncritical client traffic 2) route traffic to fallback proxy pool 3) scale gateway. Doing steps now.

Jordan: runbook check -> /runbooks/inference-gateway/5xx-spike. Action 2 suggests enabling proxy-fallback, command: `redwood-runtime switch-proxy-pool --from pool-primary-eu --to pool-fallback-eu --weight 1.0`

Kim: executing scale -> `kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-gw --replicas=14` (running now).

Sam: enabling fallback routing: `redwood-runtime switch-proxy-pool --from pool-primary-eu --to pool-fallback-eu --weight 1.0` -> accepted. ops-bot: starting warm-up of fallback pool.

ops-bot: fallback pool warm-up started (pool-fallback-eu). warming replicas: 8 -> health checks in progress.

Maria: throttling low-priority customers: updating rate-limits for client-tier=free to 10rpm. `redwood-console` changes pushed.

Kim: PD note: I've set incident priority to high and added customer-impact label (regions: eu-west1). Notifying support.

Jordan: monitoring metrics after initial actions: 5xx_rate dropped from 9.8% -> 4.6% in 90s. latency still elevated (p95 ~1200ms).

Sam: looking at backend pool, a subset of proxies saw kernel-level connection resets. I've opened a kernel upgrade rollback on canary hosts. Rolling back canary on proxy-12/13 via orchestration: `orch rollback proxy-12,proxy-13 to image proxy:v2.9.7`.

Kim: good. also enabling automated retry circuit breaker on gateway to convert some 502 bursts to quick fail + retry to fallback. `inference-gw config set --retry 2 --backoff 150ms`

pagerduty-bot: PD escalation: 10:10 UTC -> escalation level 2 (SRE lead paged).

Jordan: quick customer impact calc: from logs ~ total requests in last 5m = 320k, failed 5xx = 28k -> 8.75% overall, eu-west1 portion ~ 120k requests with 24k failures -> 20% failure for eu-west1. That's non-trivial; recommend incident template email to CSMs.

Maria: drafting customer note: "We're investigating elevated 5xx rates in EU region; prioritizing mitigation and will update in 30 minutes." pinging CSM for approvals.

Sam: rollback completed for two problematic proxies, health checks green. fallback pool at 95% warmed.

Jordan: after rollback + fallback, 5xx_rate now 0.9% (stable for 2 consecutive 1m windows). p95 dropped to 360ms.

Kim: thanks. continuing to observe. keeping PD incident open until stable for 20m. assigning follow-ups: 1) jenkins job to add kernel revert test (Jordan) 2) postmortem owner (Kim) 3) customer comms (Maria).

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-INC-4521 acknowledged by Kim (oncall).

Maria: CSMs notified, scheduled external update at +30m if stabilized.

Jordan: adding logs and span traces to the incident timeline. noting that canary deploy triggered kernel tuning that likely caused ephemeral connection resets on high-load proxies.

Sam: created emergency fat rollback of canary to prevent churn: `deployctl rollback --tag=canary-20260315 --target=eu-west1` -> accepted.

ops-bot: metric alert suppressed for 15m to avoid noise during mitigation.

Kim: ok team — once we're stable for 20m I'll run the post-incident checklist and start the SEV write-up. If errors resurge, re-open paging. :thumbsup:

Jordan: +1. logging final snapshot and wrapping.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-4521 status -> monitoring. last update posted.

Kim: handing off at 03:40 UTC to next oncall (Jordan) for the 4hr watch. leaving notes in incident doc. :wave:

Jordan: acknowledged handoff. will watch for 20m stable window, then start postmortem template.

ops-bot: incident thread closed for new automated alerts (suppression). final metrics: pre-mitigation 5xx=9.8%, post-mitigation 5xx=0.7%, customer-impact region=eu-west1 ~20% failure at peak.

Kim: closing in Slack — will keep PD incident open till postmortem. thanks all. :heart:
